_metadata.description: Per-miRNA share of reads from 3'-end isoforms (stem-loop RT captures these poorly) and per-miRNA abundance (contamination-risk flag).

source.name: isomiRdb
source.citation: Aparicio-Puerta E, et al. isomiRdb: microRNA expression at isoform resolution. Nucleic Acids Res 2023;51(D1):D179-D185.

method.three_prime_samples_note: isomiR_RPM.tsv.gz is cut by the server at ~1 GB; the 3' fractions use the complete rows before the cut. Body fluids (serum, plasma, blood) are under-represented — see sample_composition.
method.abundance: median RPM over all samples of miRNA_RPM.tsv.gz (complete, 2655 miRNAs); percentile = rank among them.
method.note: isomiRdb's isomiR matrix holds only isomiRs >1 RPM in ≥1 % of samples.

_metadata.species: Homo sapiens only (isomiRdb is human). No data for mouse/rat.
_metadata.coverage_warning: Human miRNAs in isomiRdb only. Absence of an entry means no data, not absence of 3' isomiRs.
